name: Podbase
author: podbase

sections.description:
Create and start selling custom products with zero upfront costs!

With Podbase, you can forget about inventory management and order fulfillment stress. Connect your WooCommerce store to Podbase in a few simple steps, and we’ll handle everything from printing to global delivery while you focus on staying creative and growing your brand.

Podbase offers a catalog of 300+ high-end tech accessories that pass strict quality checks. Whether you’re a creator looking to monetize your designs or a successful POD seller seeking a reliable provider — we’ve got you covered!

How does Podbase work?

When a customer buys from your WooCommerce store, the order is automatically synced to Podbase. We fulfill and ship the product directly to your customer under your own brand. You can then track your orders, revenue, and profit statistics directly from your dashboard.

Need help getting started? Check out our detailed WooCommerce integration guide:
https://help.podbase.com/integrations#main-content

With WooCommerce & Podbase you get:

  • High profit margins: No subscription fees. Our base pricing is more competitive than providers who charge monthly plans, meaning more profit stays in your pocket.
  • 24-hour fulfillment: We print and ship most orders within 24 hours, ensuring fast delivery and high client retention.
  • Worldwide delivery: Sell your products globally without limits. Podbase handles fulfillment anywhere your customers are, reliably and at scale.
  • Premium quality: With a 98.9% customer satisfaction rate, you can trust Podbase to deliver best-in-class products your customers will love.
  • Full creative freedom: Upload any designs of your choice, and we’ll make sure to bring your vision to life with vibrant, durable prints.
  • Proven reliability: Benefit from 10+ years of manufacturing experience and over 15 million orders successfully completed.
  • Professional support: Our dedicated team is ready to assist you at any time of day to ensure your business runs smoothly.

How to connect WooCommerce to Podbase?

  1. Make sure you have a Podbase account and are logged in.
  2. Install this plugin.
  3. Press “Connect to Podbase” button in the plugin.
  4. Approve permissions.
